method: Re-viewed four recent approved canonical overview sheets; read original Cycle20/22 revisions, Cycle23 V1 source and exact rendered-sequence review.

diagnosis.recurrence: V1 itself records long portrait/workplace/map holds; owner now rejects their cinematic effect.
diagnosis.supportedCause: Weak application of existing progression guidance: one plate per narration unit plus camera drift was treated as sufficient consequence. Tooling convenience, not missing policy.
diagnosis.counterevidence: Owner accepts chronology and narration. Existing rail movement and source-qualified dates are useful; wholesale script or medium change is not justified.
diagnosis.smallestCorrection: Bind an explicit shot/state ledger; compare decoded matched states at each requested defect. No new approval gate, style rule or numerical shot quota.
